label: UniFi Ultra 60W
description: UniFi Ultra 60W (USW-Ultra-60W) - 8x 1G RJ45 (1G/100M/10M): 7 PoE+ PSE ports (30 W/port) plus 1 PoE++ input port. PoE budget 52 W with the 60 W AC adapter this SKU is named for (42 W on PoE++ input, 16 W on PoE+ input, 202 W with the 210 W AC adapter). 16 Gbps switching capacity.

poe.note: 52 W models this SKU's 60 W AC-adapter configuration. Ubiquiti publishes PoE availability as a function of how the unit is powered, not as one number. techspecs 'Total PoE Availability': PoE++ input 42 W, PoE+ input 16 W, 60 W PoE adapter input 42 W, 60 W AC adapter input 52 W, 210 W AC adapter input 202 W. Max. PoE Output is PoE+ (30 W per port by PSE), so no port sources 802.3bt: port 8 of the 8 RJ45 is a PoE++ INPUT for powering the switch, and the store page states 'PoE input is supported for switch operation, with PoE+/PoE++ input or AC power required for PoE output'. The 60W/210W/60W-PoE-adapter rows are configurations of the same chassis, so a lab that powers this unit from a different adapter inherits that row, not this one.
